description: Application dates per corpus version, transcribed by hand from the text of Article 113 (and only from nodes that state the rule). Resolution: node and its ancestors (parent chain); the rule whose matching scope entry is nearest to the node wins (ties: first in `rules`); `except` removes a node (and its descendants) from a rule; no matching rule -> `default`.

default.note: General rule of Article 113: 'It shall apply from 2 August 2026.' Applies to every node without a more specific rule (including annexes and, in the Official Journal version, recitals; see README limits).

rules.note: Art. 113, third paragraph, point (a): Chapters I and II.
Art. 113, third paragraph, point (b): Chapter III Section 4, Chapters V, VII and XII and Article 78, with the exception of Article 101 (which falls under the default).
Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c): Article 6(1). The text adds 'and the corresponding obligations in this Regulation' without naming them; those are not mapped and fall under the default.

default.note: General rule of Article 113: 'It shall apply from 2 August 2026.' Applies to every node without a more specific rule (including annexes and, in the Official Journal version, recitals; see README limits).

rules.note: Art. 113, third paragraph, point (a): Chapters I and II, with the exceptions listed there.
Art. 113, third paragraph, point (a): Article 5(1), first subparagraph, points (ba) and (bb), and Article 5(1a) and (1b) apply from 2 December 2026.
Art. 113, third paragraph, point (b): Chapter III Section 4, Chapters V, VII and XII and Article 78, with the exception of Article 101 (which falls under the default).

Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c): Chapter III, Sections 1, 2 and 3, with the exception of Article 6(5) (default). Two dates by class of AI system: 2 December 2027 for systems classified under Article 6(2) and Annex III, 2 August 2028 for systems classified under Article 6(1) and Annex I. `applies_from` is the earlier date; between the two dates the result is `unknown`.

later_dates.condition: AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(1) and Annex I

rules.note: Art. 113, third paragraph, point (d): Articles 102 to 110.
